title: The Seattle Area Yoga Studios Directory & Ranking - Seattle Yoga News

facts.fact: The directory page says it compares 156 yoga studios across the Greater Seattle area.
facts.quote: Compare all 156 yoga studios across the Greater Seattle area, from Capitol Hill and Ballard to Bellevue, Everett and Tacoma.

facts.fact: The page says its 2026 ranking scores every studio on 524,682 reviews from Google, Yelp, Facebook, MindBody and ClassPass.
facts.quote: Our 2026 ranking scores every studio on 524,682 reviews from Google, Yelp, Facebook, MindBody and ClassPass.

facts.fact: The page was last updated on July 19, 2026.
The 2026 ranking counts 78 hot yoga studios among the 156 studios listed.

To be included in the ranking, a studio must be in King, Snohomish, Kitsap, or Pierce county, have yoga as a primary or core part of its business, and have a physical location with a weekly public class schedule of 5 or more classes.
facts.quote: To be included, yoga studios must be located in King, Snohomish, Kitsap, or Pierce county, have yoga as a primary or core part of their business
